where: Results > Morphology and colouration; Table 1, row 'MSZC 0142', column TD
note: New trait for this species on main: git grep of 'Gephyromantis tahotra' and 10.3897/zse.93.14906 over docs/ finds only desk-d609 eye_diameter_mm rows of these two specimens (ED cells of the same Table 1; a different measurement, no tympanum row). The cut after the ED cell leaves out cells that carry no qualifier on TD (END to TIBL and femoral-gland columns). Methods list entry (printed, reader-joined): 'horizontal tympanum diameter (TD)' and 'horizontal eye diameter (ED)'; the Methods give no further definition and no side. TD is the tympanum, not the eye, so sensory_anatomy stands. Table 1 header as read: Species | Field number | Sex | SVL | HW | HL | TD | ED | END | NSD | NND | FORL | HAL | HIL | FOTL | FOL | TIBL | FGG | FGL | FGW, so TD is the 4th numeric cell after the Sex cell (ED, the 5th, agrees with the audited eye_diameter_mm rows of this table on main); the quote is the printed row, cells joined by single spaces, the specimen is the row. Printed heading path: Results > Morphology and colouration (second-level heading under Results) ('Morphological measurements are given in Table 1.'); no Class, Order or Family heading is printed (title prints '(Anura, Mantellidae, Gephyromantis)'). Licence sentence (whole, read in three pieces on the publisher article_preview page): 'This is an open access article distributed under the terms of the Creative Commons Attribution License (CC BY 4.0), which permits unrestricted use, distribution, and reproduction in any medium, provided the original author and source are credited.' Byline as printed: Mark D. Scherz, Miguel Vences, James Borrell, Lawrence Ball, Denise Herizo Nomenjanahary, Duncan Parker, Marius Rakotondratsima, Elidiot Razafimandimby, Thomas Starnes, Jeanneney Rabearivony, Frank Glaw. Found by unfiltered WebSearch (exact title) 'A new frog species of the subgenus Asperomantis (Anura, Mantellidae, Gephyromantis) from the Bealanana District of northern Madagascar'. Species validity: Amphibian Species of the World page opened from a search result: 'Gephyromantis tahotra Glaw, Köhler, and Vences, 2011', J. Herpetol. 45: 155; comment: confused with G. ambohitra before naming, see Vences et al. 2017 Salamandra 53: 93-94; no split, synonymy or redelimitation printed; ASW comment as printed begins 'Prior to naming confused with Gephyromantis ambohitra according to the original publication.' ASW places the species in subgenus Asperomantis (Vences et al. 2017, Salamandra 53: 93). Audit 1268: Methods eye entry as printed 'horizontal eye diameter' (ED); Table 1 caption prints 'All measurements are given in mm.'

method: linear measurement with a precision calliper; Materials and methods print 'Measurements were taken by MV to the nearest 0.1 mm with a precision calliper, for the following characters (reiterated verbatim from Vences et al. 2017):' (sentence continues into the character list) and the list entry 'horizontal tympanum diameter (TD)'; units from the Table 1 caption 'All measurements are given in mm.'
conditions: Gephyromantis tahotra Glaw, Köhler and Vences, 2011, one of two newly collected specimens from Ampotsidy, Bealanana District, northern Madagascar, measured for comparison in the description of G. angano. Measured specimen: field number MSZC 0148, sex printed 'M' (male); no museum voucher printed in the row. Preserved specimen; anatomy only, hearing not tested.

Found by unfiltered WebSearch: Leptobrachella deocaensis sp. nov.
